sources.label: Alto DUSD mint and borrow documentation

reserveReview.rationale: Alto documents that only mint markets create DUSD; borrow markets redistribute lender-supplied DUSD and are not backing sources. The issuer API generated 2026-08-20 reports active mint-market DUSD debt of 32,862.242891 against sUSDe, 3,911.386452 against WETH, 398.561458 against syrupUSDC, 635.108356 against rETH, and 49,620.058653 against wstETH. A same-run Ethereum block 25796852 read found 822,997.840132 frxUSD in the DUSD USM. Combining those values yields 90.39360646% frxUSD, 5.94935962% combined WETH/wstETH/rETH collateral, 3.61325810% sUSDe, and 0.04377582% syrupUSDC; all active mint paths are identified and the V9 scoring fields remain explicit.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current issuer API mint-market DUSD debt combined with the on-chain USM underlying balance
